meta.title: Task Butler
meta.description: Your task butler for tasks, sessions, daily reports and self-evolution: keep not-yet-started thoughts in Awaiting start and drag one to Queued when it is time; new DSH workspace sessions fold in; priorities, edit/pause/resume/interrupt; scheduled fixed-format daily reports; scheduled retrospectives turn failures and your corrections into reusable lessons that are archived for review, and fold repeated workflows into DSH skills.
